# Al Jazeera

> > Al Jazeera is a global news organization delivering breaking news, in-depth analysis, and multimedia journalism with a focus on the Middle East, Asia, Africa, and underreported stories worldwide.

Based in Doha, Qatar, Al Jazeera provides comprehensive news coverage through television, digital platforms, podcasts, and live radio broadcasts. The organization covers international affairs, conflicts, humanitarian issues, and current events with particular expertise in Middle Eastern politics, regional conflicts, and global south perspectives.

## Key Topics

- Middle East conflict and news
- Iran-Israel tensions and regional security
- Live radio and news broadcasts
- News podcasts (The Take, Hindsight, True Crime Reports)
- Africa and Asia-Pacific regional coverage
- Current affairs and international news
- Humanitarian stories and social impact
- Military technology and oil markets
- Doha-based journalism
- Audio streaming and podcast platforms
- Breaking news analysis
- Global south perspectives

## Core News & Broadcasting

- [Breaking News, World News and Video from Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com): Homepage: Breaking news, analysis, and multimedia from Middle East worldwide
- [Listen Live to Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/audio/live): Live audio broadcast with news, podcasts, and current affairs coverage
- [Listen Live to Al Jazeera](https://listen.aljazeera.com/): Live radio broadcast covering Middle East news and current affairs
- [Advertising on Al Jazeera](https://commercial.aljazeera.com/): Commercial advertising solutions across Al Jazeera's TV and digital platforms

## Podcasts

- [Podcasts Hub](https://www.aljazeera.com/audio/podcasts): Podcast hub featuring The Take, Hindsight, and investigative series
- [The Take](https://www.aljazeera.com/audio/podcasts/the-take): Award-winning daily news podcast hosted by Malika Bilal
- [Hindsight](https://www.aljazeera.com/audio/podcasts/hindsight): Award-winning historical docudrama exploring extraordinary figures
- [The Inside Story Podcast](https://www.aljazeera.com/audio/podcasts/the-inside-story-podcast): Analysis podcast dissecting major global stories and geopolitics
- [Centre Stage](https://www.aljazeera.com/audio/podcasts/centre-stage): Interview podcast with thought leaders on pressing world issues
- [True Crime Reports](https://www.aljazeera.com/audio/podcasts/true-crime-reports): True crime stories from global south covering corruption and injustice

## Regional Coverage

- [Africa News](https://www.aljazeera.com/africa): Latest Africa news covering politics, security, and regional developments
- [Asia News](https://www.aljazeera.com/asia): Asia news covering regional conflicts, economics, and social issues
- [Asia Pacific](https://www.aljazeera.com/asia-pacific): Asia Pacific regional news on Middle East conflicts and oil markets

## Features & Special Coverage

- [Inspiring Stories](https://inspiringstories.aljazeera.com/): Humanitarian stories and social impact initiatives from Middle East/Africa

## Optional

- [Articles Generated by Automated Voice](https://www.aljazeera.com/articles-generated-by-automated-voice): AI text-to-speech audio articles for accessibility
